name: Earl Makrevikk
resistances: necrotic, bludgeoning, piercing and shlashing from non-magical sources

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.desc: Earl makes three attacks as a part of an attack action, only one of which can be the Domain of the Damned.

traits.name: The Song of the Sea
traits.desc:
Earl is cursed by the powers of the Ghostsea and siphons a part of its power into himself. He starts combat with 3 Legendary Break Points and gains 2 at the start of each of his rounds.

When he is at 5 points or above his whip and eyes burn with a purple-bluish flame and his gaze and smile become feral.

He can spend them as normal Legendary Break Points or use a Dreadmaw for the cost of 6 Legendary Break Points.

actions.name: The Vein
actions.desc:
Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 20ft., one target, 1d4+4 slashing and 1d4 necrotic.

This vein looking whip has a devastating effect upon its victims, who can be seen having their flesh falling off and necrosis overtake them - it deals an additional 1d4 of necrotic damage and its range is doubled. When attuned it can be stowed away in user's body mimicking a normal vein. In this state it cannot be found by a spell of 5th level or lower.

bonus.name: The Marking (Recharge 6 each)
bonus.desc:
As a bonus action Earl Makrevikk may use one of 4 marks, each having different effects:
  • Mark of the Bold - The creature within 30 feet of Earl Makrevikk receives the mark, that allows them to attack a creature one additional time, when they attack a creature.
  • Mark of the Shield - The creature receives a mark, that gives them +2 AC for the next minute.
  • Mark of the Flame - The target is marked with a mark of the flame, that makes their attack deal additional 2d8 fire damage until the end of the Earl next round.
  • Mark of the Wind - Target creatures gains additional 10 feet of walk speed for the next minute.

legendary.name: Attack (1 Break Point)
legendary.desc: Earl Makrevikk makes an attack against a creature within range.

legendary.name: Move (1 Break Point)
legendary.desc: Earl Makrevikk moves up to half of his speed.

legendary.name: Dreadmaw (6 Break Points)
legendary.desc: Earl summons a beast from the Ghostsea to devour his opponents. Each creature within 20 feet of him must make a DC17 Dexterity Saving Throw or take 3d10 necrotic damage and become Sluggish until the end of their next turn. As a maw emerges from the ground covering these unlucky enough not to dodge that in the water flames of the Ghostsea.

traits.name: Vampiric Nature
traits.desc:
The Vampire Brute has a great aversion to radiant damage. They take an additional 1d10 damage if the damage type if radiant and become enraged.

When Enraged all attacks they make are made with advantage, but all attacks against them also have advantage.

traits.name: Multiattack
traits.desc: The Vampire brute makes 3 attacks as a part of an attack action: 2 with theyr punches and 1 with bite or horns.

actions.name: Punch
actions.desc: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target, hit: 1d10+5 bludgeoning.

actions.name: Bite (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc:
Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 5ft., one target, hit: 1d6+5 slashing and 1d6 necrotic.

The Vampire Brute heals for the amount of necrotic damage dealt.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 10ft., one target, hit: 1d8+5 piercing.

bonus.name: Batshot
bonus.desc:
Ranged weapon attack: +7 to hit, reach 60ft., one target, hit: 1d6+5 necrotic.

The Vampire Brute creates an etherial bat flying towards a target within 60 feet.

reactions.name: Exploit
reactions.desc: When hit by an attack the Vampire Brute can exploit the opening, by making a melee punch attack, that deals 1d6 damage instead.
